packages/better-auth/src/cookies/session-store.ts:240-280 The account cookie is a JWE (symmetricEncodeJWT, salt better-auth-account, maxAge 300s), chunked on write and decoded plus safeJSONParse on read.

packages/better-auth/src/cookies/cookie-utils.ts:34-35,53-91,233-256 Cookie utilities define __Secure- and __Host- prefixes, a fallback comma-joined Set-Cookie splitter, and parseCookies with percent-decoding that falls back to the raw value on decode errors.

packages/better-auth/src/crypto/index.ts:16-51,54-108 Symmetric crypto: $ba$<version>$ envelope; raw encrypt/decrypt derive the key as SHA-256(secret) and use XChaCha20-Poly1305 with managed nonce, hex output; SecretConfig rotation is supported with a legacy bare-hex fallback requiring legacySecret; getCryptoKey/makeSignature use WebCrypto HMAC-SHA-256 with a base64 signature.

packages/better-auth/src/crypto/jwt.ts:12-30 signJWT/verifyJWT use jose HS256; verifyJWT returns null on any error; packages/better-auth/src/crypto/jwt.ts:41-89 symmetricEncodeJWT derives a 64-byte key via HKDF-SHA-256 (salt + fixed info string), encrypts with dir/A256CBC-HS512, sets kid to the JWK thumbprint and a random jti; packages/better-auth/src/crypto/jwt.ts:112-185 symmetricDecodeJWT allows clockTolerance 15 and A256CBC-HS512/A256GCM, matches kid to a secret version, and falls back to trying secrets in order for kid-less tokens.

packages/better-auth/src/crypto/purpose.ts:7-47 Purpose separation derives per-purpose keys via HKDF-SHA-256 (fixed salt, purpose-specific info) for five OAuth purposes, preserving rotation versions and legacySecret derivation.
packages/better-auth/src/crypto/buffer.ts:5-24 constantTimeEqual compares Uint8Array/string inputs with a length-mixed loop.

packages/better-auth/src/utils/password.ts:5-125 Password helpers assert configured length bounds; resetCredentialPassword runs token consume, optional session revocation and the password write in one runWithTransaction with documented non-rollback caveats for secondary storage; checkPassword hashes a dummy password when no credential account exists to avoid enumeration.

packages/better-auth/src/api/middlewares/origin-check.ts:221-301 validateOrigin checks origin-or-referer only when cookies are present unless forced, infers the origin from Fetch Metadata when Origin is null with sec-fetch-site same-origin, rejects missing/null origins, and re-invokes a function trustedOrigins callback per request.

packages/better-auth/src/api/middlewares/origin-check.ts:303-375 formCsrfMiddleware: with cookies it delegates to validateOrigin; without cookies it blocks cross-site navigate Fetch Metadata, forces origin validation when metadata or an Origin/Referer header is present, and passes headerless non-browser requests through.

packages/better-auth/src/api/middlewares/origin-check.ts:153-219 originCheck(getValue) validates one endpoint-specific callback URL value against trustedOrigins and is a no-op without a request or when the origin check is skipped.

packages/better-auth/src/api/middlewares/origin-check.ts:15-25,56-66 Backward-compat skip: CSRF checks are skipped when skipOriginCheck is true and disableCSRFCheck is unset, with a one-time deprecation warning.

packages/better-auth/src/auth/trusted-origins.ts:133-210 matchesOriginPattern: relative URLs match only with allowRelativePaths and isSafeRelativeURL; host-only wildcards match the host; http/https patterns match the origin exactly or by wildcard with an IPv4-range guard; custom schemes match by scheme, exact authority and path prefix, with percent-decoded traversal-normalized paths.

packages/better-auth/src/context/helpers.ts:108-165 getTrustedOrigins expands dynamic allowedHosts to https/http origins plus fallback, adds the static baseURL origin, merges options.trustedOrigins (array or per-request function) and the BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS env var (comma-split).

packages/better-auth/src/utils/url.ts:91-141,142-195 validateProxyHeader allowlists host/proto header values; getBaseURL precedence is explicit URL, then env (BETTER_AUTH_URL and framework variants), then x-forwarded-host/proto only when trustedProxyHeaders is set, then request origin, then window.location.

packages/better-auth/src/utils/url.ts:273-360,398-486 getHostFromSource/getProtocolFromSource honor forwarded headers only with trustedProxyHeaders; resolveDynamicBaseURL/resolveBaseURL resolve the per-request base URL from host/protocol sources against the DynamicBaseURLConfig allowedHosts patterns.

packages/better-auth/src/oauth2/callback.ts:25-107 exchangeOAuthCallback: RFC 9207 iss is checked only when the provider sends iss and the provider declares an issuer; id_token nonce binding fails closed when required but absent; validateAuthorizationCode failures map to INVALID_CODE; user info and the account key are resolved from provider responses, with the user parameter parsed via safeJSONParse.

packages/better-auth/src/state.ts:88-168 generateGenericState: cookie strategy encrypts StateData (including the oauthState nonce) with a purpose-derived key into a 10-minute cookie; database strategy sets a 5-minute signed state cookie and a 10-minute verification row keyed by getAuthStateVerificationIdentifier.

packages/better-auth/src/state.ts:169-308 parseGenericState: cookie strategy decrypts, schema-parses and requires oauthState equality, then expires the cookie; database strategy looks up the verification row, checks the signed state cookie unless skipStateCookieCheck is set, deletes the row, and checks expiry last in both strategies.

packages/better-auth/src/oauth2/state.ts:41-85 generateState takes callbackURL from the body or baseURL, mints a 128-char PKCE codeVerifier, spreads client additionalData before assigning serverContext (so the body cannot smuggle serverContext), and sets expiresAt to +10 minutes; parseState maps StateError codes to redirectOnError.
